elements.label: Figure 5.1
elements.title: Time series analysis involves the examination of data points collected at specific time intervals; it is crucial for identifying trends and patterns that inform predictions and strategic decisions.
elements.details: Image shows a stylized digital illustration with stacks of gold coins and a green upward trending arrow overlaid on a background of financial data and a world map. The image is decorative and symbolic of financial growth and time series trends.
elements.summary: This decorative image visually represents the concept of time series analysis and forecasting, emphasizing growth and trends in financial data.
